architecturalAssertions.assertion: Three-aisled cruciform basilica; mix of gable, tent and single-slope roofs; five bays per aisle; large west rose window with David-star stone tracery; tripartite transept window group.
Tapered square campanile, clock on each face, small balcony above third lancet, open upper arcade with three bays and two columns per side; pyramidal roof and cross.
Jan Stuyt November1919 plan shows proposed portico, independent tower and apses; proposal63.57m length is superseded by surveyed current BAG outline; not used as current dimensions.

Current orthophoto shows orange/brown terracotta tiles on nave, crossing/transept, choir, aisle roofs and visible apses. Sunlit south/east slopes are tan/red; shaded opposite slopes dark brown. Detached tower roof is grey. Blue scaffolding surrounds tower in this image.
